{{Top}}
{{Image}}
{{Quote|All wings report in.|Lando Calrissian, during the Battle of Endor|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
The term '''fighter wing''' was an organizational unit and the largest unit of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] fielded by most [[Navy/Legends|space navies]], including the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]/[[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], and the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>

==Imperial Navy==
In the navy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the fighter wing usually referred to all of the starfighters carried aboard an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], which amounted to six [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] or seventy-two starfighters and bombers. Each squadron was typically divided into three [[Flight group/Legends|flights]] of four fighters, but each flight could separate into two elements of two fighters.<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> The types of starfighters used within an Imperial fighter wing varied, with wings stationed on newer front-line vessels such as [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]]'' making greater use of advanced fighters such as the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]].<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[Ground support wing]]s attached to the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] were smaller than naval wings, consisting of ten flights of four fighters. Three flights formed a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] squadron, six flights formed two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] squadrons, and one flight flew [[TIE/fc starfighter]]s to act as spotters. In addition to the 40 [[TIE pilot|pilots]], the wing had 25 sensor techs, 25 controllers, and 60 ground crew personnel for a total of 150 men.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" /> Presumably, the naval wing had similar numbers of non-flying personnel.

==Rebel Alliance/New Republic==
Within the Rebel Alliance, and later the New Republic, a fighter wing generally consisted of three squadrons of starfighters. These wings were approximately half the size of an Imperial Navy wing, with three squadrons of twelve fighters. Three squadrons was the usual number of fighters that were stationed aboard large Rebel [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] such as [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]].<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> Squadrons assigned to the same wing that operated independently of a warship almost always flew the same types of craft. For example, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm's]] [[Defender Wing]] was originally made up of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], but later fully converted to [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]].<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
